_note: Profe's map for Spanish. The same for every learner: what each CEFR level means and what to teach, in order. Levels contain modules; a module has lessons (detailed) or, until its lessons are written, its own can-do (an outline). A lesson's {city} is filled with the learner's city. Our own wording, aligned with the sources below. Lessons are written level by level: A1 first (from the first Profe's real course), then A2 → C2.
framework: CEFR (Pre-A1 is covered by A1, module 0; 'native' is not a CEFR level: C2 is the top)
sources: Council of Europe: Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), Companion Volume, 2020
Instituto Cervantes: Plan Curricular del Instituto Cervantes (PCIC), Niveles de referencia para el español
certificates: The app estimates a level. Official Spanish certificates: DELE and SIELE (Instituto Cervantes).

levels.name: Acceso
levels.summary: Understands and uses familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases. Can introduce themselves, ask and answer simple personal questions, and interact if the other person speaks slowly.

lessons.grammar: vowels a-e-i-o-u; c/z, g/j, ll/y, ñ, r/rr, silent h; stress and written accents

lessons.title: Números 0–100
lessons.cando: say prices, phone numbers and my age
lessons.mission: Read prices aloud in a shop

lessons.title: Preguntas clave
lessons.grammar: question words: qué, dónde, cuánto, cuándo, cómo, por qué
lessons.mission: Ask a stranger: ¿Qué hora es?

lessons.title: Los 4 verbos esenciales
lessons.cando: say who I am, where I am, what I have and where I go

lessons.title: ¡Hola! Me presento
lessons.mission: Introduce yourself to someone only in Spanish

lessons.title: ¿A qué te dedicas?
lessons.cando: talk about my work and studies
lessons.mission: Ask someone what they do

lessons.title: Mi familia
lessons.mission: Describe a family photo

lessons.title: ¿Cómo eres?
lessons.mission: Describe someone at a café (in your head!)

lessons.title: Un café, por favor
lessons.mission: Order your coffee in Spanish in {city}

lessons.title: ¿Cuánto es?
lessons.mission: Ask for the bill: La cuenta, por favor

lessons.title: El menú del día

lessons.title: En el mercado

lessons.cando: say how often I do things

lessons.title: ¿Quedamos?

lessons.mission: Make a plan with someone in Spanish

lessons.title: El tiempo

lessons.title: Fiestas y costumbres
lessons.mission: Find out about a local festival in {city}

lessons.title: En la farmacia

lessons.title: ¿Qué has hecho hoy?

lessons.mission: List 5 things you've done in {city}

levels.name: Plataforma
levels.summary: Understands frequent expressions about immediate needs (shopping, work, family). Can describe their background and environment and handle simple routine exchanges.

modules.title: Mi pasado
modules.cando: tell what I did last weekend, on a trip, in a past year
modules.grammar: pretérito indefinido (regular + ser/ir, tener, hacer, estar); ayer, el año pasado

modules.title: Antes y ahora
modules.cando: describe how things used to be and compare with today
modules.grammar: pretérito imperfecto for habits and descriptions; antes / ahora; soler in the past

modules.title: Contar una historia
modules.cando: tell a simple story or anecdote in order
modules.grammar: indefinido vs imperfecto (basic); connectors: primero, luego, de repente, al final

modules.title: Comparar y elegir
modules.cando: compare things and people and explain my choice
modules.grammar: comparatives (más/menos… que, tan… como); superlatives; mejor/peor

modules.title: Casa y barrio
modules.cando: describe my home and look for a flat
modules.grammar: hay / estar; ordinals; direct object pronouns lo, la, los, las

modules.title: Trabajo y estudios
modules.cando: talk about my experience and understand simple job ads
modules.grammar: pretérito perfecto vs indefinido; llevar + time; desde / hace

modules.title: Servicios y trámites
modules.cando: make an appointment and deal with simple paperwork
modules.grammar: formal usted; polite requests (¿podría…?); tener que / hay que

modules.title: Consejos e instrucciones
modules.cando: give and follow instructions and simple advice
modules.grammar: affirmative imperative (tú, usted) + pronouns; deberías

modules.title: Planes y futuro
modules.cando: talk about future plans and conditions
modules.grammar: futuro simple; si + present, future; pensar + infinitive

levels.name: Umbral
levels.summary: Understands the main points of clear, familiar input. Can deal with most travel situations, describe experiences, hopes and plans, and give short reasons for opinions.

modules.title: Experiencias y anécdotas
modules.cando: tell experiences and anecdotes with detail and feelings
modules.grammar: perfecto / indefinido / imperfecto together; pluscuamperfecto

modules.title: Opinar y valorar
modules.cando: give and justify my opinion, agree and disagree
modules.grammar: creo que + indicative / no creo que + subjunctive; es importante que + subjunctive

modules.title: Deseos y sentimientos
modules.cando: express wishes, hopes and feelings about others
modules.grammar: present subjunctive: quiero que, espero que, me alegra que, ojalá

modules.title: Recomendar y aconsejar
modules.cando: give recommendations and react to problems
modules.grammar: te recomiendo que / te aconsejo que + subjunctive; negative imperative

modules.title: Hipótesis y condiciones
modules.cando: talk about imaginary situations and probability
modules.grammar: condicional; si + imperfect subjunctive (intro); quizás / a lo mejor

modules.title: El mundo laboral
modules.cando: handle a job interview and write a formal email
modules.grammar: formal register; relative clauses (que, donde, el que)

modules.title: Noticias y medios
modules.cando: understand the main points of news and report what others said
modules.grammar: reported speech (dice que, dijo que); passive se

modules.title: Problemas y quejas
modules.cando: explain a problem and complain politely to get a solution
modules.grammar: connectors: aunque, sin embargo, por eso; por / para

levels.name: Avanzado
levels.summary: Understands the main ideas of complex texts. Interacts fluently and spontaneously with native speakers, and can explain a viewpoint with advantages and disadvantages.

modules.title: Argumentar y debatir
modules.cando: defend a point of view in a debate with clear arguments
modules.grammar: aunque + subjunctive/indicative; concessive and causal connectors

modules.title: Lo que pudo haber sido
modules.cando: talk about past hypotheses, regrets and reproaches
modules.grammar: si + pluscuamperfecto de subjuntivo, condicional compuesto; ojalá hubiera

modules.title: Contar lo que se dijo
modules.cando: report conversations accurately, with tone and intention
modules.grammar: full reported speech with tense changes; reporting verbs (aconsejar, negar, prometer)

modules.title: Escribir con registro
modules.cando: write clear, detailed formal texts: reports, cover letters, complaints
modules.grammar: impersonal and passive structures; nominalisation; formal connectors

modules.title: Matices
modules.cando: express nuances of certainty, probability and attitude
modules.grammar: ser/estar with change of meaning; future and conditional of probability; subjunctive after relative clauses

modules.title: Cultura y expresiones
modules.cando: understand and use common idioms and cultural references
modules.grammar: idiomatic structures; diminutives and augmentatives

modules.title: Textos largos
modules.cando: follow long talks and read articles about current issues
modules.grammar: text cohesion: reference, connectors, ellipsis

levels.name: Dominio operativo eficaz
levels.summary: Understands demanding, longer texts and implicit meaning. Expresses ideas fluently and flexibly for social, academic and professional purposes.

modules.title: Leer entre líneas
modules.cando: understand implicit meaning, irony and attitude in long texts
modules.grammar: modality, evaluative language, irony markers

modules.title: Hablar en público
modules.cando: give clear, well-structured presentations on complex subjects
modules.grammar: discourse markers for structuring, emphasis and digression

modules.title: Negociar y convencer
modules.cando: negotiate, persuade and handle disagreement diplomatically
modules.grammar: hedging and politeness strategies; conditional and subjunctive for softening

modules.title: Escritura avanzada
modules.cando: write complex texts with a style suited to the reader
modules.grammar: complex subordination; stylistic word order; punctuation for style

modules.title: Expresión idiomática
modules.cando: use idioms, colloquial language and humour naturally
modules.grammar: colloquial syntax; set phrases; register shifts

levels.name: Maestría
levels.summary: Understands virtually everything heard or read. Expresses themselves spontaneously, very fluently and precisely, with fine shades of meaning.

modules.title: Precisión y matiz
modules.cando: express myself spontaneously and precisely, with fine shades of meaning
modules.grammar: full command of the verb system and modality

modules.title: Variedades del español
modules.cando: understand any variety of Spanish, at any speed, including dialects
modules.grammar: regional grammar (voseo, leísmo, ustedes vs vosotros)

modules.title: Literatura y juego de palabras
modules.cando: enjoy literature, wordplay, humour and cultural allusions
modules.grammar: literary tenses and figures of speech

modules.title: Mediación
modules.cando: summarise and reformulate information from many sources into a coherent text
modules.grammar: advanced reformulation and synthesis
